evidence_boundary: Byte custody and user pause only. No new selected control execution, tests, SSH, retirement result, capacity or scientific admission.
gzip_policy: Only bodies above 512 KiB are deterministically compressed; decoded bytes must match the original length and SHA256.
identity_policy: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True, excluding identity_sha256.
original_mode_custody: Original stat facts retained. Archive files are local 0600; Git records non-executable file mode, not private mode or inode. Cloned copies are not original live stat proofs.

original_rows.original_seal_policy: exact bytes retained; no original fields or seals added, normalized or recomputed
